title: Book Two · Chapter 162: Three Clear Answers
story:
The fifth practice page looks easy at first. A small table gives the times for three groups. Ronan sees his own age group in the middle row.

He stops before he writes. The task is about a younger visitor, not about him.

The visitor wants to use the picture books. Her group can come before lunch, but it must leave before the older group enters. Bags stay on the low shelf near the entrance. A teacher brings the books to the table.

Ronan reads the visitor's question again. He finds her row and writes the time. Then he puts a short line under bags and another under teacher.

Miss Wu asks him to explain the arrangement.

“Come at ten,” he says. “Leave your bag on the low shelf. The teacher will bring the picture books.”

“Can I take the books from the shelf myself?”

“No. The teacher brings them to your table.”

“Why do I need to leave before lunch?”

He shows the next row. “The older group needs the room then.”

Miss Wu nods. She asks him to wait while she writes. Ronan keeps his pencil still. He knows these answers. He does not need a longer answer.

After the practice, she gives him a good mark. He did the task without help. It is his third good independent result. There is one practice task left.

Ronan puts the page into his folder with the other results. He needs one more good result without help. Then he can take the final tasks for the two places.

Mei is at the next table. Her page has a good mark too. She reads the small note underneath it and asks Miss Wu about a question.

“My answer is right,” Mei says. “But the younger visitor may not know that shelf. May I point to it?”

“For a real visitor, yes. During a paper task, use the plan.”

Mei finds the shelf on the plan. She adds an arrow to her own practice copy.

In the yard, Leo asks Ronan about lunch. Ronan wants to talk about his third good result, but Leo's stomach gives a loud sound.

“Your stomach already has an answer,” Ronan says.

“It asks very clear questions too.”

They go to eat. Mei joins them with Jun a few minutes later. Jun wants to talk about a drawing of a very round horse. Mei insists that it is a cow.

Ronan looks at the page and chooses his words carefully.

“It has a good life,” he says. “There is plenty of food.”

Even Mei laughs. Jun adds a large patch of grass under the animal. They leave the picture open during lunch. No one calls the animal a horse or a cow again.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

row＝表格中的一行；visitor＝来访者；insist＝坚持说；plenty of＝充足的。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan先确认了表格中的哪个对象，避免了什么错误？
2. 第五次结束后，他还需要什么才能进入最终选拔？

## 读句子

**The teacher brings them to your table.**

拆开看：The teacher / brings / them to your table.

老师／把它们拿到／你的桌上。
